newsitem.title: USA: Cisneros Television says to buy Imagen Satelital.
newsitem.headline: Cisneros Television says to buy Imagen Satelital.

text.p: Cisneros Television Group, a member of the Cisneros Group of Cos, said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to buy Imagen Satelital for $109 million including $9 million in debt.

The company said the senior management team will re-invest in Imagen Satelital for a holding of 10 percent and will have the opportunity to exercise incentive options for an additional 10 percent holding.
Violy, Byorum & Partners LLC acted as financial advisor to the Cisneros Group.
Imagen Satelital is a Argintine cable programmer and distributor.
Cisneros Television Group, a privately-held company, operates a 24-hour animation channel with Hearst Corp called Locomotion and two Playboy branded channels with Playboy Enterprises Inc.
